counterfactual_missing_items: No pauses initially noted on Holter, disfavoring high-degree AV block
No echocardiographic evidence of prosthetic valve dysfunction or thrombus
No left ventricular dilation reported, weakening dilated cardiomyopathy
decisive_items: Notched and monophasic R-wave in V1
Absent S wave in leads I and aVL
response.rationale: R3 is directly supported by multiple raw ECG criteria diagnostic of left bundle branch block. R5 has reduced EF and diffuse hypocontractility but lacks dilation and includes regional akinesia, making it less specific. R4 relies only on PR prolongation without Holter pauses, and R1 is only historical without current valve imaging evidence.

rejected.why: Only a historical mention of prosthetic valve thrombosis; no current valve dysfunction, imaging, or embolic findings.
Only prolonged PR interval is present; Holter shows regular rhythm and no pauses, so high-degree AV block is not supported.
